subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can say what visitors can see and do in three world museums.
I can choose a museum to visit and give a reason with because.
I can write and present a guide to a museum in Oman.

tf.s: The Natural History Museum is in London.
tf.why: Yes! It is in London, England.

tf.s: The Oman Across the Ages Museum is in Muscat.
tf.why: It is in the Wilayat of Manah.

tf.s: You can learn about robot design at the Shanghai Museum of Science and Technology.
tf.why: Right! It is a science and technology museum.

tf.s: In one room of the Natural History Museum, the floor shakes.
tf.why: Yes! It shows what an earthquake feels like.

tf.s: Bait Al Zubair is in a modern building.
tf.why: Bait Al Zubair is in a traditional building.

tf.s: Bait Al Zubair is in the city of Muscat.
tf.why: Yes! The model guide says it's in Muscat.

tf.s: The speaking tip for the project is: speak quietly and fast.
tf.why: The tip is: speak loudly and clearly.

tf.s: You can see ancient tools at the Oman Across the Ages Museum.
tf.why: Yes! Ancient tools, old photographs and model boats.

tf.s: An earthquake is a mountain with fire inside.
tf.why: That's a volcano. An earthquake is when the ground shakes.

tf.s: "I want to visit … because …" gives a reason for your choice.

boxes.q: Where is the Natural History Museum?
Where is the Oman Across the Ages Museum?
In which museum can you learn about robot design?
o: Shanghai Museum of Science and Technology

boxes.q: Why does the floor shake in one room?
o: to show what an earthquake feels like
boxes.why: It helps visitors feel an earthquake safely.

boxes.q: Bait Al Zubair is in the city of ___.
Is Bait Al Zubair in a modern or a traditional building?
Which tip helps the class hear you?
boxes.why: Loud and clear speech is easy to hear.

o: In the museum, you can see …
boxes.why: This phrase tells visitors what they can see.

boxes.q: New things that people make for the first time are ___.
boxes.why: Inventions are new ideas and machines.

boxes.q: Which can you see in the Oman Across the Ages Museum?
boxes.why: It has ancient tools, old photos, paintings and model boats.

hunt.q: City of the Natural History Museum
Wilayat of Oman Across the Ages
City of the robot design museum

mcq.q: Which three museums do we read about?
o: Oman Across the Ages, Shanghai Museum of Science and Technology, Natural History Museum
Bait Al Zubair, the Louvre, the British Museum
The Technology Museum, the Space Museum, the Toy Museum
The Science Fair, the Talent Show, the Corner Shop
mcq.why: These are the three museums in the reading.

mcq.q: Which words are from this lesson?
Which sentence starts a museum guide?
o: The … museum is in the city of …
mcq.why: A guide starts with the museum and its city.

mcq.q: Name two things you can see at the Oman Across the Ages Museum.
mcq.why: It shows ancient tools, old photographs, paintings and model boats.

mcq.q: Write a sentence for your guide: what you can learn.
o: You can learn about Oman's history.
You can learned about Oman's history.
You learn can about Oman's history.
You can to learn about Oman's history.
mcq.why: can + base verb: You can learn …

mcq.q: Which sentence gives a choice and a reason?
o: I want to visit the Natural History Museum because I want to see the T-Rex.
mcq.why: I want to visit … because … gives a reason.

mcq.q: You love robots. Which museum is best for you?
o: Shanghai Museum of Science and Technology
mcq.why: You can learn about robot design there.

mcq.q: Why does one room in the Natural History Museum have a shaking floor?
o: To show visitors what an earthquake feels like.
mcq.why: Visitors can feel an earthquake safely.

mcq.q: Your guide says: "It is in a traditional building." What does this tell visitors?
o: The building is old in style, not modern.
The building is made of glass.
mcq.why: Traditional means in the old local style.

mcq.q: Why should you speak loudly and clearly in your presentation?
o: So the whole class can hear and understand you.
So you don't need a guide.
